summary: A website where customers browse your pizza menu, order for pickup or delivery, and pay online, while you update the menu and prices and watch new orders come in.

appKindRecommendation.why: Customers browse your menu and order pizza on pages they visit, while you manage prices and orders on the same site.

lookRecommendation.why: A pizza shop is a cheerful, everyday treat, and a bright, friendly look suits food photos and a quick order flow.

personas.label: Customer
personas.description: Someone ordering pizza for pickup or delivery.

personas.label: Store owner
personas.description: You, running the pizza store and managing the menu and orders.

stories.goal: see the pizza menu with descriptions and prices
acceptance: Customer opens the site and sees all current menu items with names, descriptions and prices.

stories.goal: choose pickup or delivery and give the details needed for it
acceptance: Customer picks pickup or delivery before checkout.
Delivery orders ask for a delivery address; pickup orders do not.

stories.goal: pay for the order online to complete checkout
acceptance: Customer enters payment details and the order is only placed once payment succeeds.

stories.goal: see confirmation that the order was placed
acceptance: After paying, customer sees a confirmation screen with the order summary and estimated ready time.

stories.goal: see new orders as customers place them
acceptance: Owner's order screen shows a new order appearing without reloading the page, with items, pickup/delivery choice and payment status.

stories.goal: add, edit or remove menu items and change prices
acceptance: Owner edits a menu item's name, description or price and the change is visible to customers immediately.

stories.goal: mark an order's status as it moves through preparation
acceptance: Owner changes an order from received to preparing to ready, and the change is saved.

entities.name: MenuItem
entities.description: A pizza or other menu item: name, description, price, category, and any size/topping options.

entities.name: Order
entities.description: A customer's order: items, pickup or delivery choice, delivery address if any, status, payment result.

entities.name: Customer
entities.description: Name, phone and contact details for an order; an account only if the founder chooses that option.

entities.name: StoreSettings
entities.description: Store-level details such as delivery area and whether scheduled orders are allowed.

outOfScope: Delivery driver dispatch or live tracking

questions.subject: app_kind
questions.prompt: First, what sort of thing are we building? I think it is "something people open and use" — Customers browse your menu and order pizza on pages they visit, while you manage prices and orders on the same site. Tell me if that is not right; it changes everything that comes after.

options.label: Something people open and use
options.detail: Pages people visit on a phone or a computer.

options.label: Something other software talks to
options.detail: An interface for other programs, with no screens of its own.

options.label: Something that works on its own
options.detail: It runs on a schedule or reacts to events, and decides as it goes.

options.label: Something that moves and reshapes data
options.detail: It takes data in, changes it, and passes it on.

questions.subject: other
questions.prompt: Should customers be able to customize pizzas (pick size, crust, toppings), or do you just want a fixed list of ready-made items with set prices?

options.label: Let customers customize size and toppings

questions.subject: other
questions.prompt: Should delivery be limited to a certain area, or can anyone enter a delivery address?

options.label: Limit delivery to an area I set
Accept delivery orders from any address

questions.subject: other
questions.prompt: Will anyone besides you need their own login to see and manage incoming orders, like kitchen staff?

questions.subject: other
questions.prompt: Can customers schedule a pickup or delivery for later, or should every order be for as soon as possible?

questions.subject: other
questions.prompt: Do customers need to create an account to order, or can they check out as a guest each time?

questions.subject: payments
questions.prompt: Taking payments needs your Stripe account. I'll build invite codes now and add checkout when you connect Stripe. Is that right?

assumptions: Online payment will go through your own Stripe account, which you'll connect once the app is built.
This is for a single store location.
No files were attached to this request.
